applies_why: This judge text rules on the D5/C5 Isaiah 7:14 link by comparing what the challenger and defender answered, so it is deciding the kind of collision K-C governs.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: 'by footing, never verse by verse' — I read this as requiring the whole chains' footing to be weighed rather than isolating the verse's wording from its application; the contrary reading would let the judge split the challenger's wording attack from the defender's application defense.
why: The judge labels the clash underdetermined by separating wording from application instead of weighing the DR3 and CR2/CR3 chains by footing, and it supplies no footing for that disposition.
